brand.title: AITalk
brand.description: AI speaking practice for language learners. Web and app use the same Supabase account and learning progress.

hero.eyebrow: AI speaking coach for daily practice
hero.title: Speak better every day.
hero.description: Practice real conversations, get instant feedback, and keep web and app progress in one account.

panel.prompt: Answer naturally: How would you change the booking?
panel.transcript: I would like to move my reservation to Friday evening if there is still a table available.
panel.feedback: Clear intent and natural phrasing. Try linking the last clause with a softer rising tone.

stats.label: Shared Supabase login for web and app
Short speaking sessions that fit your schedule
Practice by typing, speaking, listening and replaying
Lessons, plans and collections stay in sync

features.title: Everything needed for the speaking loop.
features.description: AITalk turns lessons into short practice sessions with prompts, voice input, AI feedback and audio playback.

cards.title: Browser voice practice
cards.text: Use microphone transcription when the browser supports it, with a text fallback when permission is denied.

cards.title: AI coach feedback
cards.text: Get corrections for meaning, phrasing, pronunciation focus and next sentence suggestions.

cards.title: Course based learning
cards.text: Continue structured plans, lesson steps and progress from the same data used by the mobile app.

cards.title: Listen and repeat
cards.text: Replay model speech with TTS so learners can shadow sentences before answering again.

workflow.title: A lesson flow that keeps learners moving.
workflow.description: Pick a level, follow the current plan, speak or type an answer, then improve from targeted feedback.

items.title: Set your learning profile
items.text: Choose native language, target language, level, goals, daily minutes and nickname during onboarding.

items.title: Practice the next step
items.text: Open the active lesson, answer prompts, review vocabulary and complete steps in order.

items.title: Track what changed
items.text: Finished lessons, collections and learning time are saved to the same Supabase user data.

sync.title: Same user system as the AITalk app.
sync.description: Web sign in uses Supabase Auth directly, so Google and Apple accounts map to the existing app user id.
bullets: Google and Apple OAuth run through the same Supabase project.
Profiles, learning plans, lesson progress and collections use auth.users.id.
No service role key is shipped to the client bundle.

cta.title: Start with one short speaking session.
cta.description: Sign in, finish onboarding, and continue the same learning plan from web or mobile.
